summary: Once the HEIC decode moved into a worker that loads heic-decode by a path computed at run time, the build trace no longer listed heic-decode or libheif-js, so the hosted functions didn't have them: every HEIC upload on the staging site answered 'unreadable' in about 2 s, while every local test passed.
fix: heic-worker.ts keeps a resolve the bundler reads (createRequire(import.meta.url).resolve('heic-decode')), so every route that uses the worker ships heic-decode and libheif-js again; the worker still loads it from the app root at run time. CI copies each such route's traced files alone and decodes a HEIC from them.
